thesis: London Stock Exchange Group is a global financial markets infrastructure and data company. **[Fact]** Four divisions serve more than 44,000 customers: Data & Analytics (subscriptions and workflow), FTSE Russell (indices and asset-based fees), Risk Intelligence (compliance screening), and Markets (trading venues, clearing via LCH, and post-trade). **[Fact]** FY2025 total income excluding recoveries was **£8,986 million** (+7.1% organic), with adjusted EBITDA margin **50.3%** and equity free cash flow **£2,445 million** (`investor-documents/ir-lseg/annual_report_2025.pdf`, Financial review). **[Fact]** Q1 2026 total income excluding recoveries was **£2,415 million** (+9.8% organic), the strongest quarterly growth in more than five years (`investor-documents/ir-lseg/trading_update_q1_2026_rns_23apr2026.pdf`). The business earns toll-like fees on market activity, index assets under management, and recurring data subscriptions with minimal principal risk on core operations.
why_market_wrong: No clear structural mispricing or dated payoff. **[Inference]** Quality croupiers (SPGI, ICE, LSEG) rarely trade to a 15% annual return; the market prices Refinitiv integration progress, AI-ready data distribution, and clearing entrenchment at a premium. **[Inference]** Q1 2026 acceleration (+9.8% organic income, Markets +15.5%) may be partly cyclical (volatile trading volumes) rather than a permanent step-up; we normalize on FY2025 equity free cash flow, not the upper half of 2026 guidance. **Predictive attribute:** none (franchise earnings at price, not yield-curve or market-structure discount).
